description: A shell script providing a utility tool 'clawlog' for viewing and filtering logs from the VibeTunnel application on macOS using unified logging system. It supports features like filtering by category, severity (error/debug), search terms, output formatting, and streaming or tailing logs, with user guidance and configuration recommendations embedded.

methods.name: handle_sudo_error
methods.description: Displays instructions for configuring passwordless sudo for the 'log' command when password prompt is encountered.

methods.name: show_usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and command options for the 'clawlog' shell utility.

methods.name: list_categories
methods.description: Lists recent log categories in the 'ai.openclaw' subsystem over the last hour.

methods.name: escape_predicate_literal
methods.description: Escapes special characters in user-provided input for safe inclusion in macOS log predicates.
